home.title: The instrument you need may already be in the lab next door.
home.subtitle: Find, compare and safely pass on used and tested laboratory equipment, with transparent data, verified sellers and specialist services.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Each category has its own technical attributes to filter on.
home.latestSubtitle: Freshly published offers from laboratories, universities and specialist dealers.
home.trustDatabase: An equipment database, not isolated adverts
home.trustDatabaseText: Every model exists once, with specifications, accessories and comments from practice. Listings hang off that record.
home.trustConditionText: Seller statements and independently verified findings are shown separately, never mixed.
home.trustFeeText: One percent of the sale price, at most CHF 500. On expensive instruments that is a fraction of the usual marketplace commission.
home.sellCtaText: Listings are free. Fees only apply once something actually sells.

qualified.title: Qualified equipment
qualified.description: Laboratory equipment that a specialist firm accredited by refreshLab has repaired, qualified and covered with a warranty of 3 to 24 months.
qualified.homeTitle: Qualified equipment: repaired and under warranty
qualified.open: refreshLab is an open marketplace: any company, medical practice or private individual can list and sell equipment here. The qualified equipment section goes one step further.
qualified.meaning: A qualified instrument has been through the hands of a specialist firm before it reaches you: the firm has inspected it, repaired it and fitted spare parts where needed, and then qualified it. It stands behind the condition with a warranty. So before you buy, you know who qualified the instrument, how long the warranty runs and what it covers.
qualified.accreditedText: Only equipment from firms accredited by refreshLab is admitted to this section – accredited for exactly this work: repairing equipment, sourcing spare parts and qualifying equipment.
qualified.termText: The warranty comes from the firm that qualified the instrument. It decides how long the warranty runs: at least 3 and at most 24 months.
qualified.scopeText: The firm also sets the scope: a full warranty covers the complete instrument, a component warranty only specific components, such as the spare parts that were fitted.
qualified.emptyTitle: No qualified equipment on offer right now
qualified.emptyText: As soon as an accredited specialist lists an instrument, it appears here.

parts.title: Spare parts store
parts.description: Laboratory equipment declared defective and offered for parts: circuit boards, fans, control knobs and door handles that still work.
parts.lead: This is where equipment declared defective is listed. It no longer runs as a whole – but many of its parts still do.
parts.text: The circuit board may still work, or the fan, a control knob or the door handle. If you run a heating oven, for example, you can find an identical unit here as a parts donor and remove what you still need. Or two instruments become one that runs again.
parts.emptyTitle: The store is empty right now
parts.emptyText: As soon as someone lists a defective instrument for parts, it appears here.

consumables.title: Consumables
consumables.description: Sell and find surplus laboratory consumables: pipette tips, filters, gloves and glassware. No chemicals.
consumables.lead: Bought too much for a project, ordered too much or cleared a whole laboratory? This is where you pass on surplus material.
consumables.text: Something is left over in almost every laboratory. Instead of gathering dust in a cupboard or ending up in the bin, that material can be listed and sold here – to someone who needs exactly that right now.
consumables.welcomeText: Tangible consumables that are not classified as hazardous: pipette tips, filters, gloves and glassware such as Erlenmeyer flasks, beakers and other glass containers.
consumables.excludedText: Chemicals, and anything classified as hazardous. With a chemical, nobody can guarantee that the container really holds what is being sold. If something goes wrong, the consequences are too serious.
consumables.emptyText: This section is being set up: consumables cannot be listed yet. Equipment is already available on the marketplace today.
